name: Firefox Browser Artifacts
location: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Roaming\Mozilla\Firefox\Profiles\<profile>\ ; places.sqlite (history/bookmarks), cookies.sqlite, formhistory.sqlite, logins.json + key4.db (saved passwords)
purpose: Stores browsing history, bookmarks, cookies, form autofill history, and encrypted saved logins in per-profile SQLite/JSON files.
normal_baseline: History reflects normal work-related browsing patterns for the profile owner.
anomalies: History entries for malicious-tool or paste-site domains
A profile folder present with no corresponding profiles.ini entry, suggesting a portable/hidden profile
anti_forensic_notes: Deleting the whole profile folder removes all Firefox artifacts at once; profile folder can be copied off intact even after the browser is closed, as recommended by Mozilla for backups.
